methodology: Production candidate is release with falcon-hybrid and without bench-internals; baseline is the original frozen benchmark binary.
One timing median per process from five measured trials; one warmup excluded from timing. The five paired seeds are the sampling units, not the 25 trial iterations.
Seeds 45-49 were already used in the frozen V2 holdout; this final-production confirmation is not a new independent holdout for the later transcript optimization.
RSS is the maximum of all six high-water observations per process, including warmup, fixture setup, retained allocator memory, and proof-digest formatting; it does not isolate the binder.

Candidate/baseline ratios are paired by seed and geometrically averaged. Exact paired bootstrap enumerates all 5^5 resamples; endpoints are type-7 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Paired-log Student-t intervals are sensitivity checks.
Intervals are descriptive, single-host, non-simultaneous, and limited to five seeds and the tested public shape. No universal nonregression or steady-state RSS claim follows.
All campaigns were audited together by observed protocol_id, not the benchmark override label; proof bytes/digests match within each protocol and input/source commitments match across protocols.
